independent_audit.method: min absolute dot per vectorized row; camera centre via linear solve; O(maxtrack) scratch; all4716points

limitations: Stable regular files required; pre/post hashes are not a race-safe snapshot reader.
Shares strict parser and quaternion rotation helper with earlier auditors; independent population check uses a different pair-angle calculation and camera-centre linear solve.
Initial serialized-model full cost differs from the rig fixture by 7.4336e-7; candidate full costs agree with earlier evidence within7.3e-10. No threshold adjusted or solver rerun.
Geometry/motion associations are not causal evidence of trajectory regression. No filtering or objective change has been evaluated.
Diagnostic wall time/RSS are not solver, mapper or native E2E performance.

Luna Max implementation agent hit its usage limit after staging completed code/tests. Root reviewed, tested, committed and measured the existing implementation; no replacement implementation model authorized.
